items.rationale: 30 <= 30 is TRUE, so the line is at its reorder point and must be reordered.
"At least" includes 50,000 itself, so the comparison is >=. Text needs double quotes.
7,200 >= 5,000 is TRUE, so the result is 7,200 x 5% = 360.
Pointing at C2 keeps the business rule in the data: change the reorder point and every flag follows.
